legendary_weapons.name: 北方巨人巨斧
legendary_weapons.desc: 每次[普通攻击]还会额外造成相当于50%武器伤害的冰霜伤害，并有3%几率冻结目标。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Each [Basic Attack] also deals 50% of Weapon Damage as Cold Damage, with a 3% chance to Freeze the target on hit.

legendary_weapons.name: 地狱风暴之锤
legendary_weapons.desc: 每使用10次 [普通攻击] 技能，召唤一道闪电打击随机敌人，造成相当于1000%武器伤害的闪电伤害。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Every 10 [Basic Attack] Abilities used, summons a Lightning Strike that deals 1000% Weapon Damage as Lightning Damage to a random enemy.

legendary_weapons.name: 苦痛锯齿巨剑
legendary_weapons.desc: 对易伤目标额外获得30%暴击几率。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Additional 30% Critical Chance against Vulnerable targets.

legendary_weapons.name: 霜龙法杖
legendary_weapons.desc: 冰碎片命中后弹射至1个额外敌人。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Ice Shards deflect to 1 additional enemy on hit.

legendary_weapons.name: 琥珀骷髅权杖
legendary_weapons.desc: 对[眩晕]或[恍惚]的敌人 +100% 暴击伤害。

legendary_weapons.name: 唤雨之弓
legendary_weapons.desc: 施放基础攻击时，有10%的几率额外免费施放奥术箭雨。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Casting a basic attack has a 10% chance to also cast Arcane Arrowstorm for free.

legendary_weapons.name: 黑鸦反曲弓
legendary_weapons.desc: 你的毒素技能命中敌人时，有15%的几率召唤一群乌鸦攻击目标，造成总计720%武器伤害的毒素伤害。
legendary_weapons.descEn: Your Poison ability hits have a 15% chance to summon a flock of crows to attack the target, dealing a total of 720% weapon damage as Poison damage.

legendary_armor.name: 无底药带
legendary_armor.desc: 药水使用次数+4。
legendary_armor.descEn: Increase Potion Charges by 4.

legendary_armor.name: 唤风者之靴
legendary_armor.desc: 击杀后4秒内移动速度+50%。
legendary_armor.descEn: +50% Movement Speed for 4 seconds after a kill.

legendary_armor.name: 暴怒壁垒
legendary_armor.desc: 若怒气护盾在结束前未被打破，结束时对周围敌人造成相当于你最大生命值100%的物理伤害。
legendary_armor.descEn: If Rage Shield is not broken before expiration, deal 100% of your Max Health as Physical Damage to surrounding enemies upon expiration.

legendary_armor.name: 荆棘之心护胸甲
legendary_armor.desc: 荆棘造成的伤害提高500%，但失去20%最大生命值。
legendary_armor.descEn: Damage dealt by Thorns is increased by 500%, but you lose 20% Max Health.

legendary_armor.name: 符文守护法衣
legendary_armor.desc: 受到敌人暴击时，获得基于你最大生命值的精神护盾。（冷却8秒）
legendary_armor.descEn: When struck by an enemy critical hit, gain a Spirit Shield based on your Max Health. (8s cooldown)

legendary_armor.name: 堕落王冠
legendary_armor.desc: 击杀后3秒内攻击速度+30%。
legendary_armor.descEn: +30% Attack Speed for 3 seconds after a kill.

legendary_armor.name: 绯红风暴之兜
legendary_armor.desc: 旋风斩每次命中有几率施加[流血]。
legendary_armor.descEn: Whirlwind has a chance to inflict [Bleeding] on each hit.

legendary_armor.name: 奥术之刃护胫
legendary_armor.desc: [附魔]技能的暴击伤害+150%。
legendary_armor.descEn: +150% Critical Hit Damage from [Enchanted] Abilities.

legendary_armor.name: 坚毅药剂护胫
legendary_armor.desc: 饮用生命药水后，5秒内获得30%伤害减免。
legendary_armor.descEn: Gain 30% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds after consuming Health Potion.

legendary_armor.name: 甲壳尖刺护肩
legendary_armor.desc: 护甲的10%也会计入荆棘。
legendary_armor.descEn: 10% of your Armor also contributes to Thorns.

legendary_armor.name: 元素爆发护肩
legendary_armor.desc: 使用[强力攻击]技能后，6秒内火焰伤害和闪电伤害+50%。
legendary_armor.descEn: After using a [Strong Attack] Ability, gain +50% Fire and Lightning Damage for 6 seconds.

legendary_armor.name: 怒火护手
legendary_armor.desc: 烈焰打击有30%几率不消耗法力。
legendary_armor.descEn: Flame Strike has a 30% chance to cost no Mana.

legendary_armor.name: 势不可挡护手
legendary_armor.desc: 技能每次命中获得1%护甲，持续5秒。（最多叠加100层）
legendary_armor.descEn: Each Ability hit grants 1% Armor for 5 seconds. (Max 100 stacks)

legendary_armor.name: 霜晶殓袍
legendary_armor.desc: 一件缀满永霜结晶的破烂披风，取自一位在被遗忘的墓穴前冻毙已久的守墓人。
legendary_armor.descEn: A tattered cloak crowned with everfrost crystals, torn from a warden long frozen at a forgotten tomb.

legendary_armor.name: 烬暮披风
legendary_armor.desc: 裁自一座在日落时分覆灭的宫廷旗帜，琥珀色的褶皱中仍留存着那最后暮光的余温。
legendary_armor.descEn: Cut from the banners of a court that fell at sundown, its amber folds still hold the warmth of that final dusk.

legendary_armor.name: 落叶行者靴
legendary_armor.desc: 怒拳的每层还额外提供 +1% 闪避几率。
legendary_armor.descEn: Each stack of Furious Fist also grants +1% Dodge Chance.

legendary_armor.name: 无尽涌流之器
legendary_armor.desc: 灵气涌流不再治疗你，转而脉动释放相当于本应回复量200%的闪电伤害，打击周围的敌人。
legendary_armor.descEn: Spirit Stream no longer heals you. Instead it pulses, dealing Lightning damage to nearby enemies equal to 200% of the healing it would have restored.

legendary_armor.name: 唤雷护手
legendary_armor.desc: 闪电风暴 +150% 暴击伤害。
legendary_armor.descEn: +150% Critical Damage with Lightning Storm.

legendary_armor.name: 游风之冠
legendary_armor.desc: 旋风棍式将掀起4道龙卷风，但每道体积缩小25%，且游走时间缩短。
legendary_armor.descEn: Whirlwind Staff conjures 4 tornados, but each is 25% smaller and wanders for a shorter time.

legendary_armor.name: 雪裘披风
legendary_armor.desc: 一件厚实的雪白毛皮披风，曾属于一处被无尽寒冬掩埋的山隘的最后一位守望者。
legendary_armor.descEn: A thick cloak of snow-white fur, worn by the last warden of a mountain pass buried beneath an endless winter.

legendary_armor.name: 暮羽之翼
legendary_armor.desc: 陨落的苍穹哨卫遗下的褐金色双翼，羽间仍留存着被遗忘时代最后一缕光的余温。
legendary_armor.descEn: Tawny wings of a fallen sky sentinel, their feathers still warm with the last light of a forgotten age.

legendary_armor.name: 无尽法力腰带
legendary_armor.desc: 饮用生命药水时还会立即恢复40%的最大法力值。
legendary_armor.descEn: Drinking a Health Potion also instantly restores 40% of your Maximum Mana.

legendary_armor.name: 战饮腰带
legendary_armor.desc: 饮用生命药水后，全部伤害 +35%，持续6秒。
legendary_armor.descEn: Drinking a Health Potion grants +35% All Damage for 6 seconds.

legendary_armor.name: 愈行之靴
legendary_armor.desc: 移动时每秒恢复3%最大生命值。
legendary_armor.descEn: Restore 3% of Max Health per second while moving.

legendary_armor.name: 不屈胸甲
legendary_armor.desc: 生命值低于30%时受到伤害，进入无敌状态，持续4秒。（冷却25秒）
legendary_armor.descEn: Taking damage while below 30% Health makes you Invulnerable for 4 seconds. (25s cooldown)

legendary_armor.name: 灵巧胸甲
legendary_armor.desc: 获得相当于闪避几率50%的额外物理伤害减免。
legendary_armor.descEn: Gain bonus Physical Damage Reduction equal to 50% of your Dodge Chance.

legendary_armor.name: 卸力缠手
legendary_armor.desc: [怒拳]的每层还额外提供 +1% 闪避几率。
legendary_armor.descEn: Each stack of [Furious Fist] also grants +1% Dodge Chance.

legendary_armor.name: 穿心护手
legendary_armor.desc: 飞刀连击和二连矢可穿透1个目标。
legendary_armor.descEn: Knife Barrage and Twin Arrows can pierce through one target.

legendary_armor.name: 溃烂护手
legendary_armor.desc: 你的持续伤害提高80%。
legendary_armor.descEn: Your Damage Over Time deals 80% increased damage.

legendary_armor.name: 专注头箍
legendary_armor.desc: 每次普通攻击获得1层专注，持续10秒，最多叠加5层。下一次强力攻击消耗所有专注，每层使该次攻击额外造成20%伤害。
legendary_armor.descEn: Each Basic Attack grants 1 stack of Focus for 10 seconds, up to 5 stacks. Your next Strong Attack consumes all Focus, dealing 20% extra damage per stack.

legendary_armor.name: 幻影面具
legendary_armor.desc: [幻影形态]持续期间获得+100%奥术伤害和+100%毒素伤害。
legendary_armor.descEn: Gain +100% Arcane Damage and +100% Poison Damage while [Phantom Form] is active.

legendary_armor.name: 魔能护腿
legendary_armor.desc: 击杀敌人后，获得15点法力恢复，持续4秒。
legendary_armor.descEn: Killing an enemy grants 15 Mana Regeneration for 4 seconds.

consumables.name: 初级生命药水
consumables.desc: 立即恢复25点生命，随后3秒内恢复30%最大生命值。

consumables.name: 中级生命药水
consumables.desc: 立即恢复50点生命，随后3秒内恢复30%最大生命值。

consumables.name: 超级生命药水
consumables.desc: 立即恢复300点生命，随后3秒内恢复35%最大生命值。

chests.name: 璀璨镀金宝箱
chests.desc: 开启后获得大量物品，有几率获得传说或神圣品质装备。

materials.name: 恶魔头骨
materials.desc: 从恶魔身上获得的坚硬头骨，可用于制作药剂和装备强化。

materials.name: 星叶草
materials.desc: 夜晚会发出微光的稀有草药，用于炼金术制作。

materials.name: 橡树叶
materials.desc: 国王森林常见的橡树叶，基础炼金材料。

materials.name: 铁矿石
materials.desc: 基础矿石，用于武器和防具强化。

materials.name: 蘑菇
materials.desc: 潮湿地区常见的蘑菇，可用于炼制基础药水。

materials.name: 金矿石
materials.desc: 稀有矿石，用于高级装备制作。

materials.name: 沙漠玫瑰
materials.desc: 塔赞荒漠特有的植物，稀有炼金材料。

materials.name: 诅咒精华碎片
materials.desc: 从黑暗生物身上采集的诅咒精华碎片，用于装备强化。

materials.name: 镀金宝箱
materials.desc: 开启后获得若干物品，可能含有宝石和银色装备。

materials.name: 黄金宝箱
materials.desc: 稀有宝箱，开启后可能获得金宝石和金色传说装备。

materials.name: 金宝石
materials.desc: 金色宝石，仅从黄金宝箱中获得，用于高级宝石镶嵌。

materials.name: 银宝石
materials.desc: 银色宝石，仅从镀金宝箱和黄金宝箱中获得，用于中级宝石镶嵌。
materials.source: 镀金宝箱 / 黄金宝箱

necklace.name: 涌动心智吊坠

necklace.name: 裂创怒吼吊坠
necklace.desc: 怒吼将立即引爆周围敌人身上残余的[流血]伤害。

necklace.name: 火焰领主项链
necklace.desc: 火元素将额外召唤一个火元素。
necklace.descEn: Fire Elemental will summon one additional Fire Elemental.

necklace.name: 精力吊坠
necklace.desc: 生命值高于80%时，全部伤害 +75%。
necklace.descEn: +75% All Damage while you are Healthy (above 80% HP).

legs.desc: [火焰]、[闪电]和[奥术]技能的暴击伤害+150%。
legs.descEn: +150% Critical Hit Damage from [Fire], [Lightning] and [Arcane] Abilities.

ring.name: 巨龙血牙印戒
ring.desc: 半月斩将额外掷出两道月牙刃。
ring.descEn: Half Moon Slash hurls two additional crescent blades.

ring.name: 展露之戒
ring.desc: 静止不动时，每秒获得+10%普通攻击伤害，最多叠加20层。
ring.descEn: While standing still, gain +10% Basic Attack Damage every second, stacking up to 20 times.

ring.name: 天目指环
ring.desc: 神圣法球将额外召唤一颗法球。
ring.descEn: Sacred Orbs conjures one additional orb.

ring.name: 第四火焰之戒
ring.desc: 每第4次火球会化为炎爆术，追踪目标并轰然炸裂，伤害爆炸范围内的所有敌人。
ring.descEn: Every 4th Fire Ball becomes a Pyroblast that seeks its target and erupts, damaging all enemies caught in the blast.

ring.name: 充能指环
ring.desc: 你的技能造成至多50%的额外伤害，随法力充盈程度提升。
ring.descEn: Your abilities deal up to 50% increased damage, scaling with how full your Mana is.

ring.name: 奥术精准之戒
ring.desc: 奥术技能获得+9%暴击几率。
ring.descEn: Arcane abilities gain +9% Critical Hit Chance.

ring.name: 屠龙戒
ring.desc: 战斗中仅剩1个存活敌人时，你的攻击速度提高35%。
ring.descEn: Your Attack Speed increases by 35% while in combat with only one living enemy remaining.

weapon.name: 黑鸦反曲弓
weapon.desc: 你的毒素技能命中敌人时，有15%的几率召唤一群乌鸦攻击目标，造成总计720%武器伤害的毒素伤害。
weapon.descEn: Your Poison ability hits have a 15% chance to summon a flock of crows to attack the target, dealing a total of 720% weapon damage as Poison damage.

gloves.name: 怒火护手
gloves.desc: 烈焰打击有30%几率不消耗法力。
gloves.descEn: Flame Strike has a 30% chance to cost no Mana.

gloves.name: 势不可挡护手
gloves.desc: 技能每次命中获得1%护甲，持续5秒。（最多叠加100层）
gloves.descEn: Each Ability hit grants 1% Armor for 5 seconds. (Max 100 stacks)

gloves.name: 唤雷护手
gloves.desc: 闪电风暴 +150% 暴击伤害。

gloves.name: 卸力缠手
gloves.desc: [怒拳]的每层还额外提供 +1% 闪避几率。
gloves.descEn: Each stack of [Furious Fist] also grants +1% Dodge Chance.

gloves.name: 穿心护手
gloves.desc: 飞刀连击和二连矢可穿透1个目标。
gloves.descEn: Knife Barrage and Twin Arrows can pierce through one target.

gloves.name: 溃烂护手
gloves.descEn: Your Damage Over Time deals 80% increased damage.

back.name: 霜晶殓袍
back.desc: 一件缀满永霜结晶的破烂披风，取自一位在被遗忘的墓穴前冻毙已久的守墓人。
back.descEn: A tattered cloak crowned with everfrost crystals, torn from a warden long frozen at a forgotten tomb.

back.name: 烬暮披风
back.desc: 裁自一座在日落时分覆灭的宫廷旗帜，琥珀色的褶皱中仍留存着那最后暮光的余温。
back.descEn: Cut from the banners of a court that fell at sundown, its amber folds still hold the warmth of that final dusk.

back.name: 雪裘披风
back.desc: 一件厚实的雪白毛皮披风，曾属于一处被无尽寒冬掩埋的山隘的最后一位守望者。
back.descEn: A thick cloak of snow-white fur, worn by the last warden of a mountain pass buried beneath an endless winter.

back.name: 暮羽之翼
back.desc: 陨落的苍穹哨卫遗下的褐金色双翼，羽间仍留存着被遗忘时代最后一缕光的余温。
back.descEn: Tawny wings of a fallen sky sentinel, their feathers still warm with the last light of a forgotten age.

back.name: 棕色冒险者披风
back.desc: 一件彰显冒险老手身份的披风。
back.descEn: A cape that marks a seasoned adventurer.

back.name: 红色冒险者披风
back.desc: 一件彰显冒险老手身份的披风。
back.descEn: A cape that marks a seasoned adventurer.

back.name: 灰色冒险者披风
back.desc: 一件彰显冒险老手身份的披风。
back.descEn: A cape that marks a seasoned adventurer.

back.name: 圣光之翼
back.desc: 一对彰显圣光虔诚信徒身份的辉耀之翼。
back.descEn: Radiant wings that mark a devoted follower of the Light.

back.name: 灰烬领主之翼
back.desc: 自灰烬之主倒下之处扯下的双翼，焦黑的翼膜仍灼烧着他那火山王座的熔炉之热。
back.descEn: Wings torn from the Lord of the Cinder where he fell, their charred membranes still glowing with the furnace-heat of his mountain throne.

weapon.name: 祖母之锤
weapon.descEn: +5% Critical Hit Chance and +120% Critical Hit Damage.

weapon.name: 裂魂之刃
weapon.desc: 每次命中有25%几率获得一层[收割灵魂]。消耗25层释放灵魂冲击，对附近所有敌人造成相当于800%武器伤害的物理伤害，并使其陷入[恍惚]。
weapon.descEn: Every hit has a 25% chance to gain a stack of [Harvest of Souls]. Consumes 25 stacks to release Soul Impact, dealing 800% Weapon Damage as Physical Damage to all nearby enemies and applying [Dazed] to them.

boots.name: 唤风者之靴
boots.descEn: +50% Movement Speed for 4 seconds after a kill.

chest.name: 暴怒壁垒
chest.desc: 若怒气护盾在结束前未被打破，结束时对周围敌人造成相当于你最大生命值100%的物理伤害。
chest.descEn: If Rage Shield is not broken before expiration, deal 100% of your Max Health as Physical Damage to surrounding enemies upon expiration.

chest.name: 荆棘之心护胸甲
chest.desc: 荆棘造成的伤害提高500%，但失去20%最大生命值。
chest.descEn: Damage dealt by Thorns is increased by 500%, but you lose 20% Max Health.

chest.name: 符文守护法衣
chest.desc: 受到敌人暴击时，获得基于你最大生命值的精神护盾。（冷却8秒）
chest.descEn: When struck by an enemy critical hit, gain a Spirit Shield based on your Max Health. (8s cooldown)

helm.name: 堕落王冠
helm.descEn: +30% Attack Speed for 3 seconds after a kill.

helm.name: 绯红风暴之兜
helm.desc: 旋风斩每次命中有几率施加[流血]。
helm.descEn: Whirlwind has a chance to inflict [Bleeding] on each hit.

necklace.name: 涌动心智吊坠
necklace.desc: 每消耗100点法力，4秒内暴击几率+20%。
necklace.descEn: Every 100 Mana spent, +20% Critical Hit Chance for 4 seconds.

necklace.name: 裂创怒吼吊坠
necklace.desc: 怒吼将立即引爆周围敌人身上残余的[流血]伤害。
necklace.descEn: Rage Shout will trigger remaining [Bleeding] damage on surrounding enemies instantly.

necklace.name: 火焰领主项链
necklace.desc: 火元素将额外召唤一个火元素。
necklace.descEn: Fire Elemental will summon one additional Fire Elemental.

legs.name: 坚毅药剂护胫
legs.desc: 饮用生命药水后，5秒内获得30%伤害减免。
legs.descEn: Gain 30% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds after consuming Health Potion.

ring.name: 巨龙血牙印戒
ring.desc: 半月打击将额外掷出两道月牙刃。
ring.descEn: Half Moon Strike will hurl two additional crescent blades.

ring.name: 展露之戒
ring.desc: 静止不动时，每秒获得+10%普通攻击伤害，最多叠加20层。
ring.descEn: While standing still, gain +10% Basic Attack Damage every second, stacking up to 20 times.

shoulder.name: 甲壳尖刺护肩
shoulder.descEn: 10% of your Armor also contributes to Thorns.

shoulder.name: 元素爆发护肩
shoulder.desc: 使用[强力攻击]技能后，6秒内火焰伤害和闪电伤害+50%。
shoulder.descEn: After using a [Strong Attack] Ability, gain +50% Fire and Lightning Damage for 6 seconds.

weapon.name: 北方巨人巨斧
weapon.desc: 每次[普通攻击]还会额外造成相当于50%武器伤害的冰霜伤害，并有3%几率冻结目标。
weapon.descEn: Each [Basic Attack] also deals 50% of Weapon Damage as Cold Damage, with a 3% chance to Freeze the target on hit.

weapon.name: 地狱风暴之锤
weapon.desc: 每使用10次 [普通攻击] 技能，召唤一道闪电打击随机敌人，造成相当于1000%武器伤害的闪电伤害。
weapon.descEn: Every 10 [Basic Attack] Abilities used, summons a Lightning Strike that deals 1000% Weapon Damage as Lightning Damage to a random enemy.

weapon.name: 苦痛锯齿巨剑
weapon.desc: 对易伤目标额外获得30%暴击几率。
weapon.descEn: Additional 30% Critical Chance against Vulnerable targets.

weapon.name: 霜龙法杖
weapon.desc: 冰碎片命中后弹射至1个额外敌人。
weapon.descEn: Ice Shards deflect to 1 additional enemy on hit.

gloves.name: 怒火护手
gloves.desc: 烈焰打击有30%几率不消耗法力。
gloves.descEn: Flame Strike has a 30% chance to cost no Mana.

gloves.name: 势不可挡护手
gloves.desc: 技能每次命中获得1%护甲，持续5秒。（最多叠加100层）
gloves.descEn: Each Ability hit grants 1% Armor for 5 seconds. (Max 100 stacks)

legendary_jewelry.name: 涌动心智吊坠
legendary_jewelry.desc: 每消耗100点法力，4秒内暴击几率+20%。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Every 100 Mana spent, +20% Critical Hit Chance for 4 seconds.

legendary_jewelry.desc: 怒吼将立即引爆周围敌人身上残余的[流血]伤害。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Rage Shout will trigger remaining [Bleeding] damage on surrounding enemies instantly.

legendary_jewelry.name: 火焰领主项链
legendary_jewelry.desc: 火元素将额外召唤一个火元素。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Fire Elemental will summon one additional Fire Elemental.

legendary_jewelry.name: 巨龙血牙印戒
legendary_jewelry.desc: 半月打击将额外掷出两道月牙刃。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Half Moon Strike will hurl two additional crescent blades.

legendary_jewelry.desc: 静止不动时，每秒获得+10%普通攻击伤害，最多叠加20层。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: While standing still, gain +10% Basic Attack Damage every second, stacking up to 20 times.

legendary_jewelry.name: 天目指环
legendary_jewelry.desc: 神圣法球将额外召唤一颗法球。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Sacred Orbs conjures one additional orb.

legendary_jewelry.name: 第四火焰之戒
legendary_jewelry.desc: 每第4次火球会化为炎爆术，追踪目标并轰然炸裂，伤害爆炸范围内的所有敌人。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Every 4th Fire Ball becomes a Pyroblast that seeks its target and erupts, damaging all enemies caught in the blast.

legendary_jewelry.name: 精力吊坠
legendary_jewelry.desc: 生命值高于80%时，全部伤害 +75%。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: +75% All Damage while you are Healthy (above 80% HP).

legendary_jewelry.name: 充能指环
legendary_jewelry.desc: 你的技能造成至多50%的额外伤害，随法力充盈程度提升。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Your abilities deal up to 50% increased damage, scaling with how full your Mana is.

legendary_jewelry.name: 奥术精准之戒
legendary_jewelry.desc: 奥术技能获得+9%暴击几率。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Arcane abilities gain +9% Critical Hit Chance.

legendary_jewelry.name: 屠龙戒
legendary_jewelry.desc: 战斗中仅剩1个存活敌人时，你的攻击速度提高35%。
legendary_jewelry.descEn: Your Attack Speed increases by 35% while in combat with only one living enemy remaining.
